name: ISO-Structured Addresses
description: Automates address structuring to ISO standards — pilot use case to launch the portal.
purpose: Turn raw, unstructured customer addresses into a clean, ISO-compliant structured format, run an automated conformity check, and draft a clear customer email explaining the result.
inputs: Free-form customer address (single line or paragraph)
outputs: Structured address fields (street, number, postal code, city, country) in ISO format
Conformity report flagging compliant vs. non-compliant addresses
Ready-to-send customer email explaining the changes

name: Self-Care Request Triage
description: Identifies which incoming requests the client can handle on their own, and routes them to self-service journeys.
purpose: Automatically detect simple requests, redirect them to actions the client can complete autonomously, and cut down on manual handling by the team.
inputs: Optional: client segment and contract metadata
outputs: Triage label: self-care eligible vs. requires an agent
Routing decision for the case management system

name: Authority Letter Generator
description: Generates authority letters automatically from an Excel input file.
purpose: Produce standardized authority letters from structured Excel data, with consistent formatting and no manual document assembly.
inputs: Excel file (.xls / .xlsx) containing the required client and authority fields
outputs: Generated authority letter (PDF / DOCX) per record
Standardized formatting following the official template

name: MT103 / XML → Proof of Payment
description: Turns MT103 and XML payment messages into client-ready proofs of payment.
purpose: Read SWIFT MT103 messages or XML payment flows, extract the key payment data, and generate a clean proof-of-payment document to share with the client.
outputs: Extracted key payment fields (amount, beneficiary, reference, value date, BIC, ...)
